mapper.sql: SELECT r.review_id, CAST(r.user_id AS CHAR) AS user_id, u.nick_name AS nickname, r.state, r.position, r.reason, r.created_at, r.view_json FROM space_banner_review r JOIN user_info u ON u.user_id = r.user_id
mapper.select: WHERE r.state = 'PENDING' AND u.status = 1 ORDER BY r.created_at, r.user_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT image FROM space_banner_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_id = #{reviewId} AND state = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO space_banner_review (user_id, review_id, state, position, image) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reviewId}, 'PENDING', 50, #{image,jdbcType=BLOB}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE review_id = #{reviewId}, state = 'PENDING', position = 50, image = #{image,jdbcType=BLOB}, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), reason = NULL, reviewer_id = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL, view_json = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE space_banner_review SET position = #{position}, view_json = #{view} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_id = #{reviewId} AND state = 'PENDING'

UPDATE space_banner_review SET state = #{state}, reason = #{reason}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), image = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_id = #{reviewId} AND state = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM space_banner_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_id = #{reviewId} AND state = 'PENDING'
